description: This source file provides extension methods for the Roslyn syntax API, specifically for enhancing manipulation and generation of C# syntax nodes related to symbols, such as creating binding flags expressions and converting TypedConstants to expressions.

classes.name: SymbolSyntaxExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods to generate and manipulate C# syntax nodes related to symbol analysis, such as creating binding flags expressions and converting TypedConstant instances to syntax expressions.

methods.name: GetBindingFlagsParenthesizedExpressionSyntax
methods.description: Generates a parenthesized binary expression combining multiple BindingFlags using a specified binary operation kind.

methods.name: ToExpression
methods.description: Converts a TypedConstant to an ExpressionSyntax suitable for code generation, handling nulls, arrays, types, enums, and other constants.

methods.name: DisplayEnumConstant
methods.description: Decodes a TypedConstant representing an enum value into an expression syntax, supporting combined bit flags.

methods.name: ConvertToUInt64
methods.description: Converts various numeric object types to UInt64 for enum constant decoding.
